summary: reCentre Health has 501 five-star reviews and real recovery stories, from ACL prehab to hip replacements. But Balham is crowded: a clinic across the road has 850 reviews, and another nearby is open until 9:15pm and on Sundays.

competitors.name: Balham Physio
competitors.notes: Website first in search; online booking; tap-to-call

visibility: In our search for "physiotherapy Balham", a competitor's website came first and your own site did not appear at all, not even when we searched your name. Directory listings also show different opening hours for you: one lists 8am–9pm, another Monday 9:30am–2pm and Friday 2–9pm, while Google shows 8am–8pm.
lead: 501 five-star reviews with detailed surgery recovery stories.
Next-day appointments, an in-house gym and an exercise app.
Physio, osteopathy and Pilates under one roof.
lose: A nearby clinic is open until 9:15pm and on Sundays, which suits commuters.
A large clinic opposite you has more reviews, so it looks like the default choice.
Your surgery recovery expertise isn't obvious to someone searching after an injury.

gaps.title: People searching for you find others first
gaps.detail: Your own website didn't appear when we searched 'reCentre Health Balham'. Directories and a competitor's site did. Every patient who searches your name is one click from someone else.

gaps.title: Three different sets of opening hours
gaps.detail: Directory pages list your hours as 8am–9pm, as 'Monday 9:30am–2pm and Friday 2–9pm', and Google as 8am–8pm. Patients who see the wrong hours may not even try to book.

gaps.title: Surgery patients don't know you specialise
gaps.detail: Pre- and post-surgery rehab is where you shine, but someone searching 'ACL rehab Balham' can't see it.

gaps.title: Finished patients disappear
gaps.detail: Without follow-ups and Pilates offers after discharge, patients who loved you rarely come back for maintenance.

actions.title: Get your own website to the top of your own name
actions.why: A fast site linked from your Google profile and directories, so searches for reCentre land on you, not on a competitor.

actions.title: Let patients book any time
actions.why: Online booking captures the commuters searching in the evening.

actions.title: Offer Pilates to discharged patients
actions.why: Doable today: an email to past patients keeps them with you for the long term.

plan.title: Your new website with online booking
plan.detail: Your services, gym and specialities, with booking open 24/7.

plan.title: Speciality pages
plan.detail: ACL, hip and post-surgery rehab pages that bring in the right patients.

plan.title: Follow-ups and Pilates offers
plan.detail: Automatic messages after discharge that bring patients back.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Bookings and how you compare with Balham clinics.

search.meaning: Someone looking for a physio in Balham is far more likely to land on a competitor.

headline.title: We searched "reCentre Health Balham". Your website appeared in none of the 17 results.
headline.detail: A competitor's website appeared three times. Directories with three different versions of your opening hours filled most of the rest.

scenario: It's 9pm. Someone tears a calf muscle on a run across Tooting Common and searches "physiotherapy Balham" on their phone. The first result is another clinic's website, with a 'Book online' button and a number they can tap to call. reCentre, with 501 five-star reviews, appears only as a line in a directory list. They book the first clinic in under a minute.
nochange: Your reviews keep growing, but patients who search keep landing on directories and on the clinic that shows up first. Every month that continues, competitors with fewer reviews book patients who would have chosen you, and some of them stay for years.
